programs.title: Salvage Hunters
programs.desc: Drew and Tee are excited by the items on offer at the largest antiques market in Italy. And, they visit a picturesque town in Spain to look at a fascinating collection.

programs.title: Tanked
programs.desc: NBA center Hassan Whiteside wants a huge aquarium for his Miami home, but the 5600-litre tank won't fit through his front door and has to be delivered on a barge.

programs.title: Wheeler Dealers
programs.desc: Mike and Elvis take a gamble on a TVR Griffith. However before they can get started the guys have to pick it apart before restoring and testing the full impact of this iconic sports car.

programs.title: Ancient Aliens
programs.desc: In 2017, an object entered our solar system in such an unusual trajectory that it caused astronomers to suggest that it could be extraterrestrial. Which brings up an important question - will we have a plan for what to do if we encounter alien life?

programs.title: The Proof Is Out There
programs.sub_title: Hairy Serpents, South Pole Nazis and the Horrible Blob
programs.desc: What is this serpent like creature caught on camera and why does it have green hair? Is the discovery of an ancient antenna found beneath the waters of Antarctica proof that the Nazis once colonized the south pole? Are these large boulders in Death Valley able to move by themselves? And did a man find a gelatinous alien life form on his kitchen floor? Tony Harris and his team of experts dive into these claims to find the truth.

programs.title: Unidentified: Inside America's Ufo Investigation
programs.desc: This special updates the Unidentified series, moving UFOs from sci-fi to serious study. It uses expert and military accounts to analyze 144 sightings and their origins.
